```{r}
simplify_data <- function(dataset){
  methods <- c("diamond", "domino", "no_tool", "rwr", "robust",
               "robust_bias_aware", "firstneighbor")
  method_pattern <- paste0("(", paste(methods, collapse = "|"), ")$")
  
  dataset %>% 
    rownames_to_column("ID") %>% 
    mutate(seed_type = case_when(
    str_detect(ID, "targets") ~ "Open targets",
    str_detect(ID, "human") ~ "Human Seeds",
    str_detect(ID, "virus") ~ "Virus Seeds"
  )) %>% 
    mutate(method = str_extract(ID, method_pattern))%>%
    mutate(dataset = case_when(
      str_detect(ID, "hvidb") ~ "HVIDB",
      str_detect(ID, "intact") ~ "IntAct",
      .default = "Open targets"
    )) %>%
    column_to_rownames("ID") %>%
  mutate(group = if_else(seed_type == "Open targets",
                         "Open targets",
                         paste(seed_type, dataset, sep = " - ")))
}

simplify_data_categories <- function(dataset, seed){
  methods <- c("diamond", "domino", "no_tool", "rwr", "robust",
               "robust_bias_aware", "firstneighbor")
  categories <- c("expansion", "interaction_type", "clinical", "interactive")
  method_pattern <- paste0("(", paste(methods, collapse = "|"), ")$")
  
  dataset %>% 
    rownames_to_column("ID") %>% 
    mutate(categorised_by = str_extract(ID, paste(categories, collapse = "|"))) %>% 
    mutate(method = str_extract(ID, method_pattern))%>%
    mutate(dataset = case_when(
      str_detect(ID, "expansion|interaction_type") ~ seed,
      str_detect(ID, "clinical|interactive") ~ "Open targets",
      .default = NA
    )) %>%
    drop_na(dataset) %>%
    column_to_rownames("ID") %>%
    mutate(group = paste(paste0(categorised_by, "_filter") , dataset, sep = " - "))
}

clean_labels <- function(m) {
  simple <- sapply(strsplit(rownames(m), "\\."), function(p) paste(p[-c(1, 2)], collapse = "."))
  rownames(m) <- colnames(m) <- simple
  m
}
```

```{r}
process_simple <- function(dataset){
  groups <- unique(dataset$group)
  matrix_list <- setNames(
    lapply(groups, function(g) {
      ids <- rownames(dataset)[dataset$group == g]
      methods <- dataset %>% filter(group == g) %>% pull(method)
      sub <- dataset %>% filter(group == g) %>% select(all_of(ids))
      rownames(sub) <- methods
      colnames(sub) <- methods
      sub %>% as.matrix()
    }),
    groups
  )
  return(matrix_list)
}
```

```{r}
extract_method <- function(filename) {
  base <- str_remove(filename, "\\.nodes\\.tsv$")
  tok  <- str_split(base, "\\.")[[1]]
  last <- tok[length(tok)]
  if (last %in% methods) last else NA_character_
}
extract_filter <- function(filename) {
  hits <- filter_keywords[sapply(filter_keywords, function(k) str_detect(filename, fixed(k)))]
  if (length(hits) == 0) "unfiltered" else hits[1]
}
 
strip_method_suffix <- function(filename, method) {
  base <- str_remove(filename, "\\.nodes\\.tsv$")
  str_remove(base, paste0("\\.", method, "$"))
}

extract_seed_type <- function(filename) {
  if (str_detect(filename, "virus_seeds_intact")) {
    "Virus IntAct"
  } else if (str_detect(filename, "virus_seeds_hvidb")) {
    "Virus HVIDB"
  } else if (str_detect(filename, "human_seeds_hvidb")) {
    "Human HVIDB" 
  } else if (str_detect(filename, "targets")) {
    "Open targets"
  } else {
    "Human IntAct"
  }
}

read_module_nodes <- function(file) {
  df <- tryCatch(read.delim(file, header = TRUE), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(df) || !"name" %in% colnames(df)) {
    warning("Skipping '", file, "' -- no readable 'name' column.")
    return(character(0))
  }
  unique(as.character(df$name))
}

jaccard_matrix <- function(module_list) {
  ids <- names(module_list)
  n   <- length(ids)
  mat <- matrix(1, n, n, dimnames = list(ids, ids))
  if (n < 2) return(mat)
  for (i in 1:(n - 1)) {
    for (j in (i + 1):n) {
      a <- module_list[[i]]; b <- module_list[[j]]
      val <- if (length(union(a, b)) == 0) NA_real_ else length(intersect(a, b)) / length(union(a, b))
      mat[i, j] <- mat[j, i] <- val
    }
  }
  mat
}
```

```{r}
methods <- c("diamond", "domino", "no_tool", "rwr", "robust",
             "robust_bias_aware", "firstneighbor")
 
filter_keywords <- c("top_100", "top_50", "same_n",
                      "expansion", "interaction_type", "clinical", "interactive")

split_by_disease <- FALSE
 
top_dirs <- c("combi_out_ot", "new_filtered_outputs", "category_filter", "viral_categories")
 
node_dir_map <- top_dirs %>%
  map_dfr(function(td) {
    dirs <- list.dirs(td, recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
    dirs <- keep(dirs, ~ str_detect(.x, "(disease_)?modules/tsv_nodes$"))
    tibble(node_dir = dirs, top_dir = td)
  })
 
node_dir_map
```

```{r}
all_files <- node_dir_map %>%
  pmap_dfr(function(node_dir, top_dir) {
    files   <- list.files(node_dir, pattern = "\\.nodes\\.tsv$", full.names = TRUE)
    disease <- basename(str_remove(node_dir, "/(disease_)?modules/tsv_nodes$"))
    tibble(file = files, disease = disease, top_dir = top_dir)
  }) %>%
  mutate(
    fname       = basename(file),
    method      = map_chr(fname, extract_method),
    filter_type = map_chr(fname, extract_filter),
    seed_type   = map_chr(fname, extract_seed_type)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(method)) %>%                          
  mutate(prefix = map2_chr(fname, method, strip_method_suffix)) %>%
  filter(top_dir != "viral_categories" | filter_type %in% c("expansion", "interaction_type"))
 
same_n_files <- all_files %>% filter(top_dir == "new_filtered_outputs", filter_type == "same_n")
top_100_files <- all_files %>% filter(top_dir == "new_filtered_outputs", filter_type == "top_100")
top_50_files <- all_files %>% filter(top_dir == "new_filtered_outputs", filter_type == "top_50")
unfiltered_files <- all_files %>% filter(top_dir == "combi_out_ot", filter_type == "unfiltered")
```

```{r}
seed_types_standard <- c(
  "Virus IntAct",
  "Human IntAct",
  "Open Targets"
)

calc_similarity <- function(nodes, metric = c("jaccard", "overlap"), seed_types = seed_types_standard) {

  metric <- match.arg(metric)

  mat <- matrix(
    NA_real_,
    nrow = length(seed_types),
    ncol = length(seed_types),
    dimnames = list(seed_types, seed_types)
  )

  for (i in seq_along(seed_types)) {
    for (j in seq_along(seed_types)) {

      a <- nodes[[seed_types[i]]]
      b <- nodes[[seed_types[j]]]

      intersection <- length(intersect(a, b))

      if (metric == "jaccard") {
        value <- intersection / length(union(a, b))
      } else {
        value <- intersection / min(length(a), length(b))
      }

      mat[i, j] <- value
    }
  }

  mat
}
```

# Same n

```{r}
similarity_results_same_n <- same_n_files %>%
  filter(
    disease %in% c("hsv", "corona", "hiv"),
    method %in% methods
  ) %>%
  group_by(disease, method, seed_type) %>%
  summarise(
    nodes = list(unique(unlist(map(file, read_module_nodes)))),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = seed_type,
    values_from = nodes
  )

jaccard_results_same_n <- similarity_results_same_n %>%
  mutate(
    matrix = pmap(
      list(
        `Virus IntAct`,
        `Human IntAct`,
        `Open targets`
      ),
      ~ calc_similarity(
        list(
          `Virus IntAct` = ..1,
          `Human IntAct` = ..2,
          `Open Targets` = ..3
        ),
        metric = "jaccard"
      )
    )
  )

overlap_results_same_n <- similarity_results_same_n %>%
  mutate(
    matrix = pmap(
      list(
        `Virus IntAct`,
        `Human IntAct`,
        `Open targets`
      ),
      ~ calc_similarity(
        list(
          `Virus IntAct` = ..1,
          `Human IntAct` = ..2,
          `Open Targets` = ..3
        ),
        metric = "overlap"
      )
    )
  )
```

```{r}
jaccard_plot_data_same_n <- jaccard_results_same_n %>%
  select(disease, method, matrix) %>%
  mutate(
    matrix = map(matrix, ~ as.data.frame(as.table(.x)))
  ) %>%
  unnest(matrix) %>%
  rename(
    seed_1 = Var1,
    seed_2 = Var2,
    jaccard = Freq
  ) %>%
  filter(method != "no_tool") %>%
  mutate(jaccard = ifelse(is.na(jaccard) & seed_1 == seed_2, 1, jaccard)) %>%
  mutate(jaccard = ifelse(is.na(jaccard) & seed_1 != seed_2, 0, jaccard))

disease_names <- list("corona" = "SARS-CoV-2", 
                      "hiv" = "HIV-1", 
                      "hsv" = "HSV-1")
disease_top_n <- list("corona" = "15", 
                      "hiv" = "5", 
                      "hsv" = "2")

for(d in c("corona", "hiv", "hsv")){
  p <- jaccard_plot_data_same_n %>% filter(disease == d) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = seed_2, y = seed_1, fill = jaccard)) +
      geom_tile(color = "white") +
      geom_text( aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", jaccard)), size = 4) +
      facet_wrap(~ method, ncol = 3, nrow = 2) +
      scale_fill_gradientn( colours = rdylbu_cols, limits = c(0, 1), na.value = "grey90")+
      scale_y_discrete(
        limits = rev(c(
          "Virus IntAct",
          "Human IntAct",
          "Open Targets"
        ))
      ) +
      labs(
        x = NULL,
        y = NULL,
        fill = "Jaccard",
        title = paste("Jaccard Similarity Index -", disease_names[d], "- Top", disease_top_n[d])
      ) +
      coord_fixed() +
      theme_bw() +
      theme(
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
      )
  ggsave(paste0("plots/jaccard_same_n_", d, ".jpeg"), width = 9, height = 6)
  print(p)
}


```

```{r}
combine_triangle_data <- function(jaccard_data, overlap_data, seed_types) {
  # position of each seed type in the desired display order
  pos <- setNames(seq_along(seed_types), seed_types)

  jaccard_data %>%
    rename(value_jaccard = jaccard) %>%
    left_join(
      overlap_data %>% rename(value_overlap = overlap),
      by = c("disease", "method", "seed_1", "seed_2")
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      pos_1 = pos[as.character(seed_1)],
      pos_2 = pos[as.character(seed_2)],
      value = case_when(
        pos_1 == pos_2 ~ 1,        # diagonal: leave blank (or set to 1 if you'd rather show it)
        pos_1 <  pos_2 ~ value_overlap,   # above diagonal -> overlap
        pos_1 >  pos_2 ~ value_jaccard    # below diagonal -> jaccard
      ),
      metric = case_when(
        pos_1 == pos_2 ~ "diag",
        pos_1 <  pos_2 ~ "overlap",
        pos_1 >  pos_2 ~ "jaccard"
      )
    )
}

make_diagonal_steps <- function(seed_types) {
  n <- length(seed_types)
  pts <- data.frame(x = 0.5, y = n + 0.5)  # start: top-left corner of the grid

  for (k in 1:n) {
    y_top <- n - k + 1.5  # top edge of diagonal cell k
    y_bot <- n - k + 0.5  # bottom edge of diagonal cell k
    pts <- rbind(
      pts,
      data.frame(x = k + 0.5, y = y_top),  # across the top of cell k
      data.frame(x = k + 0.5, y = y_bot)   # down the right side of cell k
    )
  }
  pts
}
```


```{r}
combined_plot_data_unfiltered <- combine_triangle_data(
  jaccard_plot_data_unfiltered,
  overlap_plot_data_unfiltered,
  seed_types_unfiltered
)

for (d in c("corona", "hiv", "hsv")) {
  diag_cells <- data.frame(
    seed_1 = seed_types_unfiltered,
    seed_2 = seed_types_unfiltered
  )

  p <- combined_plot_data_unfiltered %>%
    filter(disease == d) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = seed_2, y = seed_1, fill = value)) +
      geom_tile(color = "white") +
      geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(is.na(value), "", sprintf("%.2f", value))), size = 4) +
      geom_tile(
        data = diag_cells,
        aes(x = seed_2, y = seed_1),
        inherit.aes = FALSE,
        fill = NA,
        color = "black",
        linewidth = 0.8
      ) +
      facet_wrap(~ method, ncol = 3, nrow = 2) +
      scale_fill_gradientn(colours = rdylbu_cols, limits = c(0, 1), na.value = "grey90") +
      scale_x_discrete(limits = seed_types_unfiltered) +
      scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(seed_types_unfiltered)) +
      labs(
        x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "Similarity",
      ) +
      coord_fixed() +
      theme_bw() +
      theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), 
            axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
            strip.text = element_text(size = 13),
            axis.text = element_text(size = 12))

  ggsave(paste0("plots/module_overlap/combined_unfiltered_", d, ".jpeg"), width = 9, height = 6)
  print(p)
}
```
